This will be very frequently used feature, which should be maintained by all community to provide as easy as possible method to update project between versions of Godot.

I have project which can be used to track progress of this utility:
All nodes without scripts - [The-worst-Godot-test-project-Without-Scripts.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/files/4474372/The-worst-Godot-test-project-Without-Scripts.zip)
All nodes with scripts - [The-worst-Godot-test-project.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/files/4474375/The-worst-Godot-test-project.zip)
answers.workaround: Without project update tool, users will have to spend a lot of time with converting project to bigger version.
